parameters.name: Edition
parameters.description:
The type of the instance to query. Valid values:

*   **0**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance of the Insurance mitigation plan
*   **1**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance of the Unlimited mitigation plan
*   **2**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance of the Chinese Mainland Acceleration (CMA) mitigation plan
*   **3**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance of the Secure Chinese Mainland Acceleration (Sec-CMA) mitigation plan
*   **9**: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance of the Profession mitigation plan

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of instances to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-instance-ids --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --edition 9 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-zvp2eibz0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
